method.readout: Required IoU .30, changed-pixel recall .50. Native earlier crop bounds round the corresponding edges outward.
method.truth: Project the earlier and edited native arrays at the same fixed downsampling settings, then compare exact RGB before WebP. The small edit family constrains the authored change to a 52-pixel square selected by exact change density.
method.variants: Use pinned earlier photos with ancestry separate between development and held. Include an area projection not used by the detector. Use distinct edit types, prior loss, ordinary appearance changes, and wrong framing.
